canonicalOctoEarth.description: Conductors close inside Earth ionosphere & liquid core. Symmetrical arms.
canonicalOctoEarth.realThrustDelivered: 0.00 N (Physical zero: internal forces cancel by Newton's 3rd Law)
canonicalOctoEarth.ruling: PHYSICAL FAILURE AS STANDALONE THRUST (Honest simulation of prompt specification)

solarWindPlasmaCircuit.concept: Octo-Earth with External Solar Wind Return Circuit
solarWindPlasmaCircuit.description: Conductors extend beyond magnetopause; momentum reaction partner is solar wind ion stream.
solarWindPlasmaCircuit.ruling: ORBITAL TARGET ACHIEVED UNDER DECLARED ENABLERS

unmodeledPhenomena: Multi-body dynamic joint vibration and resonance (frequencies < 1e-4 Hz)
Thermal gradient expansion across day/night terminator
Torsional flutter under non-symmetric magnetic drag
Joint friction, bearing fatigue, and micro-meteoroid degradation

enablers.name: High-Density Fusion/Antimatter Reactor Array
enablers.bound: Maximum sustained continuous power capacity P <= 1.0e22 Watts (10 Zettawatts)
enablers.rationale: Provides the necessary ~5.4 ZW continuous power for planetary acceleration over 10,000 years. Requires full waste heat dissipation via high-temperature ring radiators.

enablers.name: Theoretical Carbon Nanotube / Graphene Structural Arm Composite
enablers.bound: Tensile yield strength sigma_yield <= 100.0 GPa, Density rho >= 1300.0 kg/m^3, E <= 1.0 TPa
enablers.rationale: Enables articulated arm components up to 12,000 km in Earth's gravity field without immediate catastrophic self-weight tensile rupture.

enablers.name: Interplanetary Solar Wind Magnetized Plasma Return Circuit
enablers.bound: Plasma momentum coupling efficiency eta <= 0.85; loop closure strictly beyond magnetopause (> 10 R_earth)
enablers.rationale: Allows electrodynamic arms to interact with external momentum partner (solar wind ions), preventing Newton's Third Law cancellation that occurs with internal Earth ionospheric loops.
